data.name: Fikriyya
data.long_meaning: Fikriyya is an Arabic name derived from the root 'fakara' which means to remember or to think. This name signifies a person who is deeply engaged in their thoughts and memories. In Islamic context, Fikriyya is a name of high reverence as it is associated with the remembrance and contemplation of Allah.
